description: Source code for ESP32 multiprocessor support in Zephyr OS, including CPU startup, logging, and inter-processor interrupts.

methods.name: smp_log
methods.description: Logs messages via UART, required for reliable startup on ESP32.

methods.name: appcpu_entry2
methods.description: Entry point for secondary CPU, sets up interrupt vectors and starts execution.

methods.name: z_appcpu_stack_switch
methods.description: Assembly routine to switch stack and jump to entry point.

methods.name: appcpu_entry1
methods.description: Initial CPU entry that calls stack switch.

methods.name: esp_appcpu_start
methods.description: Starts the application CPU with a specified entry point.

methods.name: arch_start_cpu
methods.description: Initializes and starts a secondary CPU core.

methods.name: arch_sched_ipi
methods.description: Sends an inter-processor interrupt to another core.

methods.name: arch_cpu_active
methods.description: Checks if a CPU core is active.
